title: Paid Antonym - Part (VI) (SSC CGL 2023)

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.
My energy waned to see my college team performing poorly in the match.
questions.solution:
D)Waned(verb) – To decrease in strength, intensity, or size, to diminish, reduce. घटना/ गिरावट होना
Antonym:Grew(verb) – To increase in size, amount, intensity, or quality. बढ़ना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.
She is a veteran journalist known for her powerful writing style.
questions.solution:
D)Veteran(noun) – A person who has had long experience in a particular field, especially in the military. अनुभवी
Antonym: Novice(noun) – A person new to or inexperienced in a field or situation, beginner. नौसिखिया

questions.question:
Choose the ANTONYM of the word 'fetish' in the given sentence.
Shilpi has a fixed indifference and obsession towards problems in life.
questions.solution:
A)Fetish(verb) – the fact that somebody spends an unreasonable amount of time doing only a particular activity or thinking only about a particular thing किसी विशिष्ट वस्तु के बारे में सोचते हुए या किसी विशिष्ट काम में बहुत ज़्यादा समय लगाना
Antonym:Indifference(noun) – Lack of interest, concern, or sympathy; apathy. उदासीनता

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.
The boy looked disheveled and lost.
questions.solution:
A)Disheveled(adjective) – Messy, untidy, unkempt, ruffled.बेढंगा
Antonym:Tidy(adjective) – Neat, organized, orderly, clean.सुव्यवस्थित

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.
The apple tasted incredibly sweet .
questions.solution:
C)Sweet(adjective) – Having the pleasant taste characteristic of sugar or honey; not salty, sour, or bitter. मीठा
Antonym:Bitter(adjective) – Having a sharp, pungent taste or smell; not sweet.कड़वा

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.
I must have a chance to rectify my error.
questions.solution:
A)Rectify(verb) – To make right, correct, amend, or adjust.सुधारना
Antonym:Worsen(verb) – To make or become worse, deteriorate, degrade.बिगाड़ना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.
My complaint is that the gardener dozes off during work.
questions.solution:
C)Complaint(noun) – An expression of dissatisfaction, grievance, unhappiness.शिकायत
Antonym:Praise(noun) – Expression of approval, admiration, or compliment.प्रशंसा

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.
The lizard's light brown skin acts as camouflag in the desert sand.
questions.solution:
C)Camouflage(noun) – The use of any combination of materials, coloration, or illumination for concealment, either by making animals or objects hard to see, or by disguising them as something else. छला वरण लगाना
Antonym:Reveal(verb) – To make (previously unknown or secret information) known to others; to uncover, to show, to display. प्रकटकरना
